name: Craftsman's Writ: Wild Leather Shoulders
summary: A transferable writ requests Wild Leather Shoulders and gives a delivery place and payment details. You need the writ in hand to complete the exchange.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: A faded note asks you to bring Wild Leather Shoulders to the place marked for delivery. It also gives the payment details. The writ can pass from one bearer to another, but you need it with you for the exchange.

faq.answer: The writ requests one pair of Wild Leather Shoulders.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the shoulders?
faq.answer: The writ gives a delivery location, marked on your map.

faq.q: What does the writ say about payment?
faq.answer: The writ includes information about payment.

faq.q: Can I pass the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ says it can be transferred.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: Yes. You need to have the writ with you to complete the exchange.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Wild Leather Shoulders
